heading: Hello, I'm Kim.
body:
On Instagram you might know me as Knack for Creativity Photo. I've been in the photography game for about seven years, and it has been the best journey.

I picked up a camera at my church at 17, and that's what led me here. It's also how I fell in love with concert settings and stage lighting. Since then I've shot concerts, weddings, maternity sessions, church services, graduations, models and behind-the-scenes work. I'm always up for a challenge and for pushing my creativity somewhere new.

I recently finished my Master's in Forensic Psychology at ASU (Forks Up!), but the arts are where my mind gets to roam free.

When I photograph your moment, I want your personality to shine through. The first hellos and smiles of a shoot mean so much to me, and I love giving clients what they asked for and then some.
